`preset` scope already keeps eac"},{"id":"p17s2","text":"h preset's memories apart."},{"id":"p18s1","text":"Two things to know about the row:"},{"id":"p19s1","text":"- the `config` block **replaces** the plugin's defaults wholesale — list

key);
- to swi"},{"id":"p19s4","text":"tch the plugin off again, set `disabled: true` on the row (or
remove the preset row) and restart."},{"id":"p20s1","text":"### Mounting the plugin twice"},{"id":"p21s1","text":"Two rows can reach one session: the profile-wide row plus an agent-preset
row, against DIFFERENT ban"},{"id":"p21s2","text":"ks. The session's PRESET mount then owns its
automatic recall: every automatic surface (the turn-sta"},{"id":"p21s3","text":"rt snapshot, the

snapshot"},{"id":"p21s4","text":" - the preset bank's card - with the profile-wide bank's standing

that session"},{"id":"p21s7","text":": no second snapshot, no prefetch, no mid-step or

is redundant: th"},{"id":"p21s12","text":"e second mount's refreshes retire the first mount's cards,

so the surface converges on one bank's cards."},{"id":"p22s1","text":"### The configuration keys"},{"id":"p23s1","text":"| key | default | what it does |"},{"id":"p24s1","text":"| `bank` | — | **Required.** The name of the Hindsight bank to use (the server creates it on first u"},{"id":"p24s2","text":"se). |
| `baseUrl` | `http://127.0.0.1:8888` | Your Hindsight server's address. |
| `apiKeyRef` | — "},{"id":"p24s3","text":"| **The way to give the plugin its key** — a *name* for the secret, not the secret itself. The value"},{"id":"p24s4","text":" is looked up on every call (environment → `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` → `.env` files), so rotating t"},{"id":"p24s5","text":"he key needs no restart and the key never sits in a config file. See below. |
| `apiKey` | — | A pla"},{"id":"p24s6","text":"in key in the config, instead of a reference. Prefer `apiKeyRef`. |
| `autoContext` | `true` | Set `"},{"id":"p24s7","text":"false` to turn off the automatic recall (each turn's first step, any human intervention claimed mid-"},{"id":"p24s8","text":"turn, the mid-step agent-output recall, the post-compaction recall, and the opt-in pre-execution les"},{"id":"p24s9","text":"son gate; the `hindsight` tool stays). |
| `prefetch` | `true` | `true` (default): the recall starts"},{"id":"p24s10","text":" as the *previous* turn ends, so from the second turn on it targets the previous message. `false`: e"},{"id":"p24s11","text":"very turn queries the message you just sent and waits on the server for it — the memory is always re"},{"id":"p24s12","text":"levant to what you just said, at the cost of the server's latency on every first model call. |
| `re"},{"id":"p24s13","text":"callContextTurns` | `5` | How many of your recent turns ride along in the recall's query, so the ban"},{"id":"p24s14","text":"k can match memories against what the conversation was about, not just the last message.
